requirements.description: Read Exodus 16:1 to 17:6. Discuss with your Pathfinder Club, unit or class the challenges the people of Israel faced after they left their homes in Egypt.
Explain what the word refugee means and the circumstances that force people to leave their homes.
List the immediate needs a refugee has on arriving in your country.
Find out about the organizations in your community that assist refugees and immigrants.
Listen to or watch a presentation about an immigrant that includes information contrasting the culture of their new community with that of their former community. Take notes.
Write a one-page report telling what you have discovered in completing the requirements for this honor. Give recommendations on ways refugees can be helped.
